text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Police arrest over 10 workers at a university in northern Zambia after they besiege the vice chancellor office to press demands for better pay.
- Church leaders call on Zambians to reject political leaders advocating violence.
- Former president Kenneth Kaunda's son, former parliamentarian Wezi Kaunda, is discharged of treason felony charges in a Lusaka court.
- About 500 jobs are to be created in the tourism sector following the approval of 30 applications from would be tour operators.
- Lonrho Cotton creates 750 jobs and hopes to expand its operations further.
